headers.comment: NOT immutable. public/css/app.css and public/js/*.js keep stable filenames across commits (Tailwind runs locally and there is no build step on Vercel to content-hash them), so an immutable year-long cache means a redeploy keeps serving the PREVIOUS bundle and edits silently appear to do nothing. Revalidate every time instead: the cost is one conditional 304 per file, and it removes an entire class of 'my change vanished' debugging.
